name: drupal/ai_playwright
description: Gives Drupal AI Agents eyes on a rendered page - a Playwright browser tool that returns a screenshot, title, text and console errors so the Drupal Canvas AI assistant can see and verify what it builds. Config-driven and framework-agnostic.

suggest.ext-node: Node.js 18+ with Playwright (npm install playwright && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium) is required on the server for the browser tool to run.
